item.title: KS Besøksbidrag
item.description: Short description Technical documentation for KS Besøksbidrag KS Besøksbidrag is a national service that supports municipalities in administering the visitor levy for accommodation. The accommodation levy is regulated by the Visitor Levy Act (besøksbidragsloven) and the Regulations on the accommodation levy (forskriften om overnattingsavgift). The service offers: An open municipality register (Register API) of municipalities with visitor levy, and the periods in which it applies Reporting of accommodation turnover through an Altinn form (coming) Reporting through an API for automated submission from your own systems (coming) Status: Currently only the Register API is available. The API may change until 1 December. The reporting schema will be published through Altinn later, and this page will be updated when it is ready.
